name: 415 · IDoc Guard · ENTERPRISE · Atlantic Retail Order Portfolio

parameters.content:
## Atlantic Retail Distribution · enterprise IDoc portfolio

Creates sixteen structurally complete `ORDERS05` documents against A4H/250. Twelve represent realistic retail and distribution scenarios; four are deliberate SAP application exceptions.

The portfolio covers standard replenishment, urgent demand, shortage risk, third-party fulfilment, serial numbers, FIFO batches, expiry-managed batches, advanced shipping and mixed baskets. Technical values remain in English and use live SAP master data.
